prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a huge iron golem of dark grey riveted iron plates, a barrel chest with a glowing orange furnace grate in the middle, a small square head with two glowing orange eye slits, thick arms with huge iron fists wrapped tight in heavy chains, thick legs; drawn compact with the arms close to the body, tall and filling the box, centred in its own cell with empty space on both sides. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: a small square iron head with two glowing orange eye slits.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, stepping forward and smashing one chain-wrapped fist down onto the ground just in front of its front foot, the elbow bent, the furnace glowing brighter, the fist well inside the middle cell (not reaching the cell edge), facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, leaning away from the heroes, both fists raised in front of the chest, the furnace flickering, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight clearly onto one leg, twist the torso and swing the iron fists with the elbows bent, so every reaching part stays well inside its own cell. Draw only the parts named in the description, the same in every cell: no loose chains, sparks, smoke, smear or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a human face, bronze, stone blocks, clay, a blade arm, a cannon, swinging chains, loose chains, smoke, flames outside the grate.
